speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Daylight is on the close. I can see the kennel from here, and it is still white. Dinner is when I said. I am not calling before that.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Once, at dinner. I have it. There is a clean sheet upstairs and I have not touched it yet.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: I will clear this when you are gone up. I am not coming to look at a sheet. The latch is the news I had, and I have spent it.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Go up, then. Leave the crust if you are leaving it. I am not making a second breakfast out of a man who has a page to write.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: The crust can stay. I am going up.
